'''Warped fungus''' is a secret [[ingredient]] from [[Hell]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Invisibility}}. Picking it up only unlocks a recipe for 2 cyan dye; its foods never appear in the recipe book.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/warped_fungus.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Secret ingredient ===
{{Spoiler}}
Warped Fungus is cooked like a mushroom: braised into [[Braised Warped Fungus|braised warped fungus]] (Invisibility, 0:30), pickled with a brown mushroom into [[Pickled Warped Fungus|pickled warped fungus]] (a splash potion of Invisibility for 5 minutes) and cooked with steak, dough and milk into [[Warped Stroganoff|warped stroganoff]] (Invisibility, 10:00) and tops the [[Warped Pizza|warped pizza]] (Invisibility 5:00 and Strength 3:00). Cooking it grants the advancement ''Hidden Flavors''. See [[Secret recipes]].
